test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.**

I am reviewing a book by Ruskin Bond.

options.text: A book by Ruskin Bond has been reviewed by me.
A book by Ruskin Bond would be reviewed by me.
A book by Ruskin Bond is being reviewed by me.
A book by Ruskin Bond was to be reviewed by me.

solution:
The correct answer is: **A book by Ruskin Bond is being reviewed by me.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and in the Present continuous tense and we need to change it in the passive form.
 
• The Present continuous tense in the active voice has the following form: **Subject + be verb (is, am, are) + present participle(ing) + object**__
 
• The Present continuous tense in the passive voice has the following form: __**Subject + be (is, am, are) + being + past participle + by object**__
 __
 
• Active: *My boss is giving me many assignments.*
 
• Passive: * Many assignments are being given by my boss.*
 
 
 
• In the active voice of the Present continuous tense, we have to change the structure, so the subject in the passive voice becomes the object in the active voice.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct Active Voice:__ *A book by Ruskin Bond is being reviewed by me.*
